title: A pharmacy's duties for emergency medication kits under 247 CMR 9.09
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.09(1) a pharmacy shall maintain a policy and procedure for the proper dispensing of medication through emergency medication kits pertaining to security, maintenance, and use. Under 9.09(2) a pharmacy shall reconcile medication dispensed through emergency medication kits with prescriptions or orders. Under 9.09(3) a pharmacy may only provide emergency medication kits to types of facilities approved by the Board.
exam_relevance: Tests the Board's regulation of the pharmacy that supplies emergency medication kits, separate from the Department's facility rules and circular letters.
common_confusions: Reconciliation under 9.09(2) is a pharmacy duty, matching what left the kit to prescriptions or orders.
A pharmacy may not supply a kit to a type of facility the Board has not approved.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-17 in the current official PDF of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (pages dated 12/6/24).
